name: Varberg - Åkulla
description: Varberg to Åkulla. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: Varbergs tourist and urban service cluster (lodging)
waterSources: Dricksvatten Åkulla Outdoor Resort: Official tap/fill point at Åkulla Outdoor Resort.
notes: Official GPX/API geo_json is a 225-point 21.070 km LineString starting at 57.110104,12.249553. Official API line.geometry starts 322.4 m west at 57.109547,12.244312 and computes 21.913 km. OSM starts about 360 m west and computes about 22.050 km. Naturkartan reportedly starts at the GPX start but ends at the shared Åkulla junction.
Official N8 GPX ends about 60-65 m from the shared Åkulla junction used by N6/N7/M1. Naturkartan reportedly ends within about 1 m of the shared junction.

Official page/API says 22 km; official GPX description says 21.1 km and computes 21.070 km; Naturkartan says 21.0 km; OSM relation sums about 22.050 km; AllTrails says 21.9 km; Pacer says 13.7 mi; Outdooractive says 22.3 km; En Vandringssaga says 21 km.
Hallandsleden says green/easy; Naturkartan says red/krävande; AllTrails/Outdooractive say moderate; Pacer says hard.

Official Hallandsleden includes Varberg - Åkulla as N8 in Norra delleden/E1. Vandra.se calls the Varberg-Åkulla day an anslutningsled to Hallandsleden, and topology shows it is a western branch into the Åkulla junction rather than a continuation from N7.

Åkturen is seasonal and 2026 bus bay details conflict between current text and timetable/PDF row. Haksered/Brännhult fallback distances are described differently by destination pages, official N8 text and coordinate-derived distances.

facilities.name: Åkulla Outdoor Resort
facilities.description: Endpoint resort with lodging, cafe/restaurant, toilets/showers, water refill, paid tent/campervan/caravan places, environmental station, dump station and fresh water for pitches.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Yasjön
facilities.description: Island shelter/campsite with fireplace near the Åkulla endpoint. Access by cable raft 1 July to mid-October; island access prohibited 1 March to 30 June for nesting birds; bring or buy firewood from Åkulla Outdoor Resort.
